data.title: Just Cavalli Villas
data.about:
Designer homes by none other than Just Cavalli! One-of-a-kind collaboration with Damac, Just Cavalli homes offer you luxury iconic villas with bold Italian crafting, reflecting the genius of Cavalli’s design and aesthetic. You will never want to leave your home. These homes offer you a lifestyle like no other. Using intriguing prints, innovative materials, rich textures and experimental graphics, Cavalli has created homes with bold exteriors in the vast green spaces.

Residents will have a choice of beautiful homes, many with rooftop terraces. Each home has vibrant designs with a variety of layouts. Residents can access the state-of-the-art gyms and the best amenities of Akoya. Just Cavalli villas are nestled in the green expanses of Akoya in Dubailand. A self-sufficient community, Akoya offers you access to the community pool, play areas, supermarket, shopping destinations, gourmet restaurants and more. Your children can attend the international school in the neighbourhood, as well as the park. Live the ultimate luxurious life at Just Cavalli villas by Damac. Book yours now.
